run_preprocess_nli_cli: run the preprocess_nli CLI to tokenize and binarize NLI data using a SentencePiece model
run_preprocess_function: run the preprocess function to tokenize text files with SentencePiece and binarize via fairseq
create_MultiprocessingEncoder: create a MultiprocessingEncoder to encode text lines as SentencePiece pieces or IDs in parallel
read_nli_jsonl: read NLI data from a JSONL file and filter samples by language
write_lines_to_file: write a list of lines to a new text file using write_lines
